allocator_adoption.reason: Allocator counters are a separate primary observation under the frozen protocol; they are not an adoption gate and do not establish a timing result.

region_peak_live_bytes_observation.claim: Five-byte peak-live observation; no meaningful adoption claim.

cleanup_review.basis: Raw replay, reduction cross-check, retained verifier, and complete rejection decision all pass; no adoption or timing claim is pending.

decision_review.reason: Primary paired native p50 gate fails both median ratio <=0.98 and bootstrap CI upper <1.0. No recapture or replacement population.

guard_regression_review.basis: All 72 child semantic receipts and the retained verifier are passing; source/correctness qualification remains bound through the plan and decision receipts.
guard_regression_review.uncertainty: The capture is a warm-cache CPU-affined shared-host trial and does not establish universal or exclusive-host performance behavior.

historical_time_comparison.restriction: No timing comparison to retained 0885 or 0887 captures was used; this review uses only the 0890 matched raw capture.

protocol_replay.schedule: native lane completed before allocator; AB/BA by (block + case_index) parity and allocator block parity

reduction_crosscheck.pooling: none; each ratio uses one child aggregate statistic and pairs are summarized by median

review_flags.interpretation: Three metric-level control flags remain visible: ordinary XLSX p99, DOCX RSS, and PPTX p99. They are review flags and are not dismissed.

rss_review.claim_restriction: RSS is retained as a review metric and carries no causal or adoption claim.
rss_review.confound: Executable residency and file-history effects can still influence peak RSS; managed copies narrow the path/inode confound but do not eliminate it.
rss_review.managed_copy_control: Before/after binaries were byte-identical to their managed copies and each role used one managed copy across children.

scope.description: Recomputed child statistics and paired ratios from retained raw reports, RSS files, receipts, and semantic receipts; no workload or build was launched.
